chapter: Bird's world, singers and the new music
title: Nothing tops Bird; pianists and Dameronia
summary: Bird and Prez sound fresh; he praises Mabern, Bishop, Harris and Flanagan.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, what do you think about this trend of a lot of the so-called Avant-Garde musicians or the New musicians, who in their repertoire, besides playing the outside stuff, will take stuff from years ago, even going back to Scott Joplin and Jelly Roll Morton and Fletcher Henderson, and play it, but it doesn't seem like it's played quite the same way. Not that you'd want them to play it exactly like that... But have you heard any of that?
I don't know whether I have or not. I don't really know whether I know what you're talking about.
Well, some of these groups have done albums of Scott Joplin's music in their own way or... You haven't heard that.
No, I haven't heard that, no.
So in other words, you really haven't heard anything since Bird that's topped that.
I haven't heard anything top Bird. Have you?
No. And I guess that's why his music sounds just as...
Fresh every day.
Yeah. Today as it did then. And that's why people are still listening to him.
McGhee (12/6) - 51
So does Prez, though.
Absolutely.

He sounds fresh as a daisy. Prez was something else. I don't know how these guys get those kind of feelings, unless they... I just don't know. I can't understand it. Maybe I will one of these days, I don't know. But after Bird I haven't heard anything.
I heard some piano players that play pretty good.
Like who, for instance?

Oh, all them piano players I know sound pretty good. Like Mab (Harold Mabeern) can play, and Walter Bishop can play. So can Barry Harris, and Tommy Flanagan can play. And what's this other guy? I have his name. But man, all the piano players seem to be able to take care of business.
They tell me Philly Joe is also playing, too. I haven't heard him and his band. I hear he has a good band.
Yeah, he does.
What is that, Dameronia or something?
Yeah.
Yeah, well, I mean, they should be. They're all seasoned players. They should be able to play something.
McGhee (12/6) - 52
[END OF TAPE IV, SIDE 2]
